title: Backtracking Explained  Solve Mazes Like a Pro!
description: Explore the essence of backtracking: a systematic problem-solving method. Like navigating a maze, it involves trying paths, hitting dead ends, and retracing steps to find the solution. Discover how this refined brute-force approach builds and discards potential solutions. #Backtracking #Algorithms #ProblemSolving #ComputerScience #Maze
